agency.name: Division of Substance Use Programs (DSU), Vermont Department of Health

narrNote: VTARR appears on NARR's official affiliate list; it is Vermont's sole NARR affiliate and the only statewide recovery-residence certifying body. DSU funds and refers but does not certify.
notes: Agency identity from SAMHSA's SSA directory (Division of Substance Use Programs, Vermont Department of Health — formerly the Division of Alcohol and Drug Abuse Programs/ADAP). DSU's System of Care page was fetched on healthvermont.gov and publishes phone 802-651-1550. VT Helplink is the state-promoted substance-use support and referral center; healthvermont.gov publishes 802-565-LINK (5465) and toll-free 833-565-LINK, 24/7. The Vermont Recovery Network now does business as Recovery Partners of Vermont (per its own site). The DVHA (Vermont Medicaid) member page lists mental health and substance use disorder services among covered services. Verification method note: vermont211.org and vthelplink.org were directly verified 2026-10-22 in the backfill pass (direct fetches in the initial run were rate-limited, HTTP 429, and the entries then rested on official-source corroboration); both returned live pages with matching content — Vermont 211 (United Ways of Vermont) and VT Helplink, Vermont's alcohol & drug support center (802-565-5465). countyDirectory is null: Vermont publishes no county-level behavioral-health directory; services run through regional designated agencies.
